Introducing Saved Views, available today for all customers on paid plans. Saved Views lets you capture the exact filters, sorting, and grouping you use most, so you can return to the perfect setup in a single click instead of rebuilding it every time. Whether you track sprint progress, monitor overdue tasks, or organize work by owner, you can now save that configuration and jump back into it instantly.

Each user can save up to 50 views, giving you plenty of room to organize views for different projects, clients, or workflows without ever running low on space. Views can also be shared with your team, so everyone works from the same setup and stays aligned on priorities, deadlines, and next steps, cutting down on repeated setup work and back-and-forth questions about how a board or list is organized.

Saved Views is included in every paid plan at no extra cost, and it's ready to use right now across your entire workspace.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
